_comment: Docking conditions. 'box' is edge length in angstrom; 'center' is site | offset | blind. Edit freely -- build_data.py reads whatever ran.

setups.label: Tight box, 18 A
setups.note: Small box. Fast, but it can exclude the crystal pose entirely.

setups.label: Standard, 24 A, exh 8
setups.note: The default most people run without thinking about it.

setups.label: Standard box, exh 32
setups.note: Same box, four times the search. Tests whether searching harder helps.

setups.label: Loose box, 34 A
setups.note: Big box. Contains every crystal pose, but scores get noisier.

setups.label: Mis-centred by 6 A
setups.note: What happens when you pick the pocket centre badly.

setups.label: Blind, whole protein
setups.note: No prior knowledge of the site. The expensive one.

setups.label: Standard + flap water
setups.note: Keeps the conserved waters that bridge ligand to protein. HIV-1 protease only.
